local-api.//: APK for testing on a real phone against the DEV machine, not production. opescare.test is a hosts-file entry that only resolves on that PC, so the phone must use its LAN address; the Apache vhost carries a matching ServerAlias, without which the phone's Host header falls through to the default vhost and gets a 403. The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi, and this IP is DHCP-assigned — re-check it before rebuilding.
